name: God Loves Me
overview: Scripture reveals that God's love is compassionate, gracious, and enduring, demonstrated through His mercy and truth toward His people. He strengthens and upholds those who trust in Him, healing the brokenhearted and binding their wounds. This steadfast love is everlasting, drawing believers with kindness and rejoicing over them with joy and singing, affirming that the Lord is always present to save and support His children.
